name: ControlPanel
rows: Yellow cells are the only scenario inputs. Word and CSV are static default-parameter delivery snapshots; after any input change, re-export them. Excel Daily, Options, eligibility, selection, and stress actions recalculate.
0%–20%; applied separately to current and stress bases
Current selection passes baseline only; execute the stress action in Options if fares rise.
Only the five yellow inputs vary. Official rates, return date, training/meal calendar, attendance choices, quotes, and city choices are fixed exercise facts.
Actual lodging reimbursement uses quoted room cost capped by the applicable lodging maximum; the cap is not treated as spending. Tax is 12% of reimbursable lodging only.
First/last-day M&IE is reduced to 75% first, then full allocated Government meal amounts are deducted, with a $5 incidental-expense floor.
Hotel complimentary breakfast is not deducted; Government meals and registration-included lunches are deducted; coffee/fruit breaks are not deducted.
Quoted facilities are not approved merely because their rates fit the model. Safety, acquisition, travel authorization, and funds checks remain approval gates.
